lines.text: These four soldiers lifted a thirty-ton tank...
Two Frenchmen are riding their bikes through the countryside, when they run into four American soldiers lifting a tank.
Mon Dieu! How is that possible?
Well... we Americans are very strong.
The trick? That tank was made of rubber. It was inflatable!
Those soldiers were the Ghost Army, and their mission was to fool the Germans.
At night, they blew up rubber tanks, trucks and cannons.
They set up speakers blasting the sound of engines, tank tracks, and soldiers at work.
They filled the radio with fake messages, from troops that were never there.
They even went to the village bars to tell lies, in case spies were listening.
From the air, the Germans saw a huge army... and moved their troops to stop it.
And who were these soldiers? Many of them were artists: painters, designers, decorators.
They fooled the German army again and again...
and the only ones who nearly caught them... were two guys on bikes.
Very strong. We're very, very strong.
